title: Topology snapshot file
description: Canonical, single-source schema for the topology snapshot file uploaded to POST /topology/snapshots. Owned by the Topology Service (the validating owner). The Simulator (producer) validates its generated file against this SAME file; there is no independent Simulator copy. Per-domain objectType/relation vocabulary (incl. Site / LOCATED_AT) is validated semantically against the Knowledge Service, not by this JSON Schema. A change to this file is a contract change (architecture.md/spec update + human approval).

schemaVersion.description: Topology-file schema version, independent of the event-model schemaVersion.

snapshotId.description: Optional producer-supplied snapshot identifier. If absent, Topology mints one inline on ingest and returns it in the 200 SnapshotIngestResponse.

domain.description: Domain-pack identifier (e.g. core-ip). Selects the Knowledge vocabulary the objectTypes/relations are validated against.

nodes.description: Typed graph nodes, including Site nodes (Site is a domain-agnostic object type carrying geo attributes).

edges.description: Typed graph edges, including LOCATED_AT edges (device LOCATED_AT Site).

managedObjectId.description: Generic objectType:id scheme. The prefix must equal objectType (checked semantically).

objectType.description: Must equal the managedObjectId prefix AND be in the domain's Knowledge object-type set (e.g. Node, LineCard, Port, Interface, IPLink, IGPAdjacency, LSP, VPNService, FiberSpan, SRLG, Site).

attributes.description: Open, structured, well-known-key-extensible attribute map. For Site nodes: latitude, longitude, region, name. Stored verbatim; not value-validated by Topology.

from.description: A managedObjectId present in nodes[] (dangling refs rejected semantically).

to.description: A managedObjectId present in nodes[] (dangling refs rejected semantically).

relation.description: Must be in the domain's Knowledge relation vocabulary (e.g. HOSTED_ON, HOSTS, TERMINATES, RIDES_ON, ADJACENCY_OVER, TRAVERSES, SERVES, MEMBER_OF, LOCATED_AT).

attributes.description: Open, structured per-edge attribute map. Stored verbatim.
